title: Backups
intro: The site automatically keeps copies of your work. Here you can see the copies made, make one whenever you like, and download one to your computer.
reason_delai: Changes had been waiting too long (you were still working)
downloadFailed: The download could not be prepared. Try again.
advice: Keep a copy on your computer from time to time: backups are stored in the same place as your site. They protect you from a slip-up, not from losing the disk. Download the latest one now and then.
alert: Warning: {message} It was due on {date}. Make a backup by hand (button below) and tell the person who looks after the site: the site log contains a “[backup] ALERTE” line with the details.
retentionText: The last {keep}, plus the last one of each of the past {days} days (Paris time). The rest is deleted at the next backup.
delayLabel: Backup even while you are working
delayText: At most every {maxHours} h when changes are waiting (otherwise after {quietMin} min without changes).
writing: Writing the archive: {done, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} of {total}
missing: Warning: {count, plural, one {# file used by your site is not in the latest backup and cannot be recreated} other {# files used by your site are not in the latest backup and cannot be recreated}} (for example <mono>{samples}</mono>). Upload these images again (or remove them from the site); otherwise they will be broken after a restore.
oldBackup: Old: without the kit drawings, imported frames or icons.
unlockBody: A backup contains the whole site database. Type your password again: downloads stay unlocked for 10 minutes.
includeMediaHelp: Without them, the copy is much lighter, but it only protects the text and the layout.
keepHelp: The latest backups (“recent”). On top of these comes the last one of each of the past {days} days (“daily”, a server setting, BACKUP_KEEP_DAYS). The rest is deleted at the next backup. Always kept as well: the most recent one older than 48 hours and the last 3 made with “Back up now” (counted separately).
quietLabel: Minutes without changes before backing up
maxLabel: Maximum hours before backing up your changes, even if you are still working
